Third-party files served locally by the demo (no CDN or font service is needed at runtime).

lightweight-charts/   TradingView Lightweight Charts 4.1.3 (npm "lightweight-charts", dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js,
                      identical to the jsdelivr copy). Apache License 2.0: lightweight-charts/LICENSE.
                      Copyright (c) TradingView, Inc. https://www.tradingview.com/
phosphor/             Phosphor Icons web font 2.1.1 (npm "@phosphor-icons/web", src/regular and src/fill: style.css + woff2/woff/ttf;
                      the SVG font files are not included and their line was removed from style.css). MIT License: phosphor/LICENSE.
ibm-plex/             IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600 and IBM Plex Mono 400/500, latin subset (npm "@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans" 5.0.20,
                      "@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono" 5.0.13). SIL Open Font License 1.1: ibm-plex/LICENSE-IBM-Plex-*.txt.
